Greg's decision, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #713, 2026-10-13 03:19Z; recorded by Termal::Fable2): "Greg chooses B for the triple: run the one correctly focused credited re-gate under w-67d2; for w-030c and w-aec234, bind their exact-tree full-gate criterion to that same host record by the narrowly documented one-time exception, with your concurrence. Greg also flags incorrect focus/credit attribution as recurrent, not incidental. Keep w-f057e4c3a0b6 at P1, require a regression covering the first post-gate tracker mutation, and prioritize its fix before the next avoidable multi-item gate after this safely launched re-gate. Do not delay the current triple solely to redesign it."
Scope: ONE-TIME, for the triple only (w-030c9a669d9a and w-aec234e3f7d0, criterion "The full gate passes on the exact committed tree"). It is NOT a standing rule. Every other multi-item landing needs either per-item gates or the host fix w-540531f46f53. The option it answered was in b9d13887 #712.
